name: Appenzell Innerrhoden
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Appenzell Innerrhoden
summary: A white square with a black bear standing upright, with red claws and tongue. It is the Catholic half of the former canton of Appenzell.
origin: After the 1597 split, Inner Rhodes kept the plain bear of Appenzell, while Outer Rhodes added letters.

symbols.name: Bear
symbols.description: A black bear standing on its hind legs.
symbols.meaning: From the arms of the Abbey of St Gall.

facts: It was the last Swiss canton to grant women the vote, by federal court ruling in 1990.
It still holds an open-air Landsgemeinde assembly.
clues: A black upright bear on white, without letters.
The last Swiss canton to give women the vote.
